author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn how to build high-speed decision-making pipelines for language models using Jev in PyTorch. This comprehensive course covers both encoder and decoder architectures, custom causal attention masking, and KV-cache reuse to bypass slow autoregressive generation. You will also explore fine-tuning techniques, teacher-student distillation, and reinforcement learning methods like GRPO to optimize decision latency and accuracy.
